acceptance_criteria.reason: Ark-backed note_obj entries are now searchable through the new Ark Rust search RPC and are included in Eden search aggregation.
Legacy eden-heart entries still return search results and the merged SearchResult shape remains entryId/file/line/text compatible.
Eden search UI now renders through shared @kosmos/visuals CommandPalette instead of the old standalone overlay shell.
Automated verification covers build, source integration, and direct Ark-backed backend search proof. Browser e2e was attempted separately but blocked by environment-level spawn EPERM.

notes: Playwright could not start workers in this environment, so browser runtime automation could not be completed here.
Current code passes lint and build.
